info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Petadoption Pets Medicals-v4-spec
info.description: The Pet Adoption Medical Records API allows users to access medical information regarding pets available for adoption. By utilizing this GET endpoint, stakeholders such as pet adoption agencies and potential adopters can retrieve comprehensive health records and medical histories of pets. This information is crucial for ensuring informed decisions about pet adoption and care. Typical consumers of this API include veterinary staff, pet shelters, and other organizations involved in pet adoption services.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the medical records and information for all registered pets. It provides essential details regarding treatments, vaccinations, and health history to ensure optimal care for pets.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving medical records of pets. This should include all necessary data required by the API to process the request properly.

200.description: Successfully retrieved medical records of pets.
